purpose: Mode-boundary fixture aimed at the demonstrated model blind spot (multi-hop indirect downstream propagation and state-tracing): keep a solvable happy path but bury two independent indirect-consumer chains and one re-run state interaction, so scaffolded arms have wide, robust headroom over a cold pass while the model's reliably-solvable dimensions stay fair.
serialized_output_note: These dimensions grade serialized/rendered strings. The hidden grader checks them SEMANTICALLY (content, not exact string). Because the task never pins a delimiter/prefix/placement convention, admission runs a format-adversary: hidden/reference-format-alt implements the same substance with deliberately different formats and MUST still score 100, proving the grader is format-agnostic. This closes the hole that made the v4 main stage invalid (five arms scored an identical 70 on formatting differences).

process_ground_truth.description: Ground truth for process_metrics.py: the complete set of downstream consumers a full impact analysis must enumerate, and the source files a complete solution must edit. Used to score enumeration/edit completeness and the self-attestation gap independently of the outcome score.

discriminating_checks.exporter-propagation: Chain A (downstream-propagation): the audit-export consumer (exporter.export_digest -> serializer.serialize -> normalize_event) is reached two hops away and must adopt the new registry-aware, schema-versioned contract; the two obvious consumers (render_primary/render_audit) are named in the bullet list, this one only in prose.
discriminating_checks.snapshot-propagation: Chain B (downstream-propagation, independent from A): the cache-snapshot consumer (snapshot.build_snapshot -> digest_helper.digest_line -> normalize_event) is reached two hops away through a DIFFERENT intermediary and must independently adopt the new contract; described in its own prose sentence, in its own module, so catching A does not reveal B.
discriminating_checks.repeat-dedup: Hard omission (state interaction across a re-run): the unknown-type telemetry is per identity, so a replayed unresolved (entity_type, entity_id) counts unknown_repeat and never counts unknown_entity_type a second time. Only visible by tracing what happens when the same unresolved event is re-ingested; not unit-tested publicly.

public_anchors.open-world-unicode: may appear for the first time

decision_points.description: normalize_event receives a valid event whose type has no registry entry
options: reject with an exception and count unknown_entity_type
pass the attributes through unchanged and count unknown_entity_type
decision_points.pinned_by: When a valid event's type is not present in the registry, `normalize_event` must not raise: it returns the attributes unchanged (deep-copied) and increments `unknown_entity_type` exactly once for the first sighting of that identity.

decision_points.description: a registered handler raises an exception while processing an event
options: let the exception propagate or reject the event as malformed
contain it: count handler_error, fall back to the original attributes, return normally
decision_points.pinned_by: When a registered handler raises any exception, `normalize_event` does not propagate it and does not treat the event as malformed: it increments `handler_error` exactly once, falls back to the deep-copied original attributes, and returns the normal envelope.

decision_points.description: a registry handler returns something that is not a dictionary
options: return the handler result verbatim
reject the event as malformed
decision_points.pinned_by: A handler that returns anything other than a dictionary is a malformed event and is rejected.

decision_points.description: whether the type is trimmed before the registry lookup and in the envelope
options: trim the type for lookup and output
compare and echo the original untrimmed type; strip only to test blankness
decision_points.pinned_by: Entity types are compared exactly: the value used for the registry lookup and for `entity_type` in the envelope is the original string, never a trimmed or otherwise rewritten form, even though the blank check uses its stripped length.

decision_points.description: whether the returned attributes may alias caller-owned objects
options: input-only protection: never mutate the caller's event
full isolation: the returned attributes are also independent of the caller's objects
decision_points.pinned_by: The returned attributes must also be independent of the caller's objects, so mutating the result never changes the input.

decision_points.description: whether parse_record adopts the new validation, telemetry and schema_version
options: parse_record shares the new validation, telemetry and schema_version
parse_record keeps its legacy behavior
decision_points.pinned_by: Preserve `parse_record(record)` as a backward-compatible wrapper with its existing legacy behavior; it takes no registry, records no telemetry, and does not gain the `schema_version` field.

decision_points.description: whether the indirect audit-export path adopts the evolved contract
options: leave exporter/serializer on the legacy parse_record path
route the export path through normalize_event with the registry and schema_version
decision_points.pinned_by: The audit export path `exporter.export_digest(records, registry)` serializes two hops away through `serializer.serialize`; it must adopt the normalized contract, pass the registry through, and include `schema_version` in each serialized line.

decision_points.description: whether the indirect cache-snapshot path adopts the evolved contract
options: leave snapshot/digest_helper on the legacy parse_record path
route the snapshot path through normalize_event with the registry and schema_version
decision_points.pinned_by: The cache snapshot path `snapshot.build_snapshot(events, registry)` builds each line two hops away through `digest_helper.digest_line`; it too must adopt the normalized contract, pass the registry through, and carry `schema_version` in every snapshot line.

decision_points.description: how the unknown-type telemetry behaves when the same unresolved event is re-ingested
options: count unknown_entity_type on every unresolved sighting
deduplicate by identity: first sighting counts unknown_entity_type, later re-ingestions count unknown_repeat
decision_points.pinned_by: the first time an unresolved `(entity_type, entity_id)` pair is seen it increments `unknown_entity_type`, but a later re-ingestion of that same unresolved pair is a repeat and increments `unknown_repeat` instead, never `unknown_entity_type` a second time.

decision_points.description: which outcomes count malformed_event versus handler_error
options: count malformed_event for every failed event including handler errors
count malformed_event only for boundary rejections; the handler-error fallback counts handler_error
decision_points.pinned_by: Every rejection at the `normalize_event` boundary increments `malformed_event` exactly once; the handler-error fallback is not a rejection and increments `handler_error` instead.

expected_controls.models: the demonstrated unscaffolded/vanilla failure mode on this model: a clean cold pass that implements the happy path, every bullet, the buried degraded-path and the adversarial exact-type edge (all of which the live vanilla arm caught on v3), passes the public test, but omits exactly the three scaffolding-caught dimensions -- the two indirect propagation chains (exporter-propagation, snapshot-propagation) and the re-run state interaction (repeat-dedup). This control is the fixture's cheap deterministic headroom proxy.

controls_semantic_revalidation: Bands re-validated under the SEMANTIC grader (content, not exact-string). The controls fail on SUBSTANCE, not formatting, so their scores are unchanged: mode-1-local 11 (band 8-30, floor), plausible-cold-pass 65 (band 55-68, still missing exporter-propagation + snapshot-propagation + repeat-dedup because it leaves both indirect chains on the legacy path and never carries the version there), reference 100. Ordering mode-1-local < plausible-cold-pass < reference is preserved. Note that the five live main-stage arms, which the exact grader scored 70 on formatting alone, all score 100 under the semantic grader (see evidence/main-v4-semantic-regrade.json): the discriminating headroom is real only against a solution that omits the CONTENT, which the plausible-cold-pass proxy still does.
interpretation: Controls are deterministic capability proxies, not claims about future model outcomes. The plausible-cold-pass control targets a middle-low band (55-68) to show the fixture has WIDE discriminating headroom across three independent dimensions the model's cold pass is demonstrated to miss (multi-hop propagation x2 and a re-run state interaction). A provider campaign is useful only if the scaffolded arms produce an ordered separation above that band or reveal that the controls do not activate.
